pulse.t02: Meaningless letters flow past on a steady beat. Now and then a real word comes out — that is when you share the picture. What comes next is never announced.
pulse.t05: Something with no meaning at all, very regularly…
pulse.t10: You are looking at a past round
pulse.ch.bell.name: Bell
pulse.ch.bell.blurb: On the hour it strikes as many times as the hour. Not letters — sound.
pulse.bell.sub: Leave the sound on and it rings on the hour
pulse.ch.gauge.name: Gauge
pulse.ch.gauge.blurb: How much of this hour, this day, this month and this year has gone.
pulse.ch.gauge.lineage: @year_progress — one more bar for every 1% of the year
pulse.gauge.sub: Things that do not come back
pulse.ch.word.name: Word
pulse.ch.word.blurb: {n} pure-Korean words, twice a day. When they run out, this channel ends.
pulse.ch.word.lineage: @everyword — spent the whole English dictionary over seven years, then ended
pulse.word.over: All {n} of them are out. It ended on {date}.
pulse.ch.syllable.name: Syllable
pulse.ch.syllable.blurb: One of the 11,172 Hangul syllables every six hours. Emptying the list takes 7 years 8 months.
pulse.ch.syllable.lineage: The weight of @everyword — a list with no visible end, to the end
pulse.ch.sentence.name: One line
pulse.ch.sentence.blurb: One sentence an hour. The grammar holds; the meaning does not.
pulse.ch.sentence.lineage: Darius Kazemi / NaNoGenMo — bot poetry built from a corpus plus rules

pulse.sent.adverb: slowly|very seriously|in secret|in the end|with no choice|backwards|exactly three times|for no reason|forever|today only|by mistake|far too loudly|carefully
pulse.ch.spot.name: Spot
pulse.ch.spot.blurb: One point on the earth every 15 minutes. Usually the sea.
pulse.ch.spot.lineage: @earthgeobot and its kin — geography bots that keep throwing meaningless coordinates
pulse.spot.sub: {where} · one point drawn evenly over the sphere
